# Planned-context memory counterexample

One isolated model read all 65,520 input tokens and generated one token with no inference error, abort, or memory-pressure cancellation. The plan charged the additional retained sequence state, but the 20 ms physical-footprint sampler still exceeded both its expected peak and the requested target. Lifetime RSS alone would have missed this transient. This is failed planning-envelope evidence, not a passing qualification or a throughput claim. VM swapouts did not increase; 31 pages were swapped in system-wide. Other applications remained open; no concurrent model or compiler was run.

Command: `slotstream context-check --model ~/.slotstream/models/qwen38-flash-next-mlx-4bit --memory-gb 10 --vision off --mtp off --tokens 65520 --sample-footprint --json`.

Binary SHA-256: `ff89ce74aedee9f466e5385af802fcce166c8a4a3b203b7061eeb21e10f0f73d`. Source and binary identity is retained below. All experimental optimizations were off.
